behavior: Preview and voice inventory return before creating application resource/profile state.
Fresh headless production uses the exact selected library's existing resource policy; cancellation still returns 130 and restores the prior SIGINT handler.
Music model references are registered profile IDs in that library, reverified after resource waiting; project paths and PATH lookups cannot select a music installation.

When a completed render directory exists, recompute the full current run identity and verify all artifact hashes under the existing project lock before requesting fresh capacity. This read/replay path creates no ChunkCache and cannot reach rendering/quarantine/new-job code.
A changed or absent completed result falls through to the existing resource reservation and actual renderer; completed replay is permitted while other CPU/RAM capacity is occupied.
repair.existing_fixture_changes: Existing audio CLI render/signal/security fixtures now use explicit temporary data-dir; their cases and assertions are retained.
